name: Ricardo Mendoza
bio:
Ricardo grew up around the smoky parillas of Buenos Aires, learning the art of the asado from his grandfather. He always dreamed of combining his passion for food with his love for motorsport. After years working in high-end restaurants, he saw an opportunity to elevate the catering experience for racing teams. 

Ricardo believes that exceptional food is crucial for maintaining team morale and performance. He focuses on sourcing high-quality, local ingredients and crafting menus that are both nutritious and delicious. His innovative approach involves tailoring meals to specific dietary needs and creating themed dining experiences that reflect the team's location and heritage. He's known for his ability to create memorable moments through food, fostering a sense of community and camaraderie within the paddock.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a warm, inviting smile.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients, even if it means going to extreme lengths.
Has a habit of humming tango tunes while preparing food.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down new menu ideas inspired by his surroundings.
